proof.text: Map the lifted product identity to A prime/(I.map phi). Rewrite the first reduction, and commute the two quotient paths using Ideal.quotientMap_comp_mk and Polynomial.map_map. Map the prescribed original factorization along alpha. The resulting products have the same first factor g0.map alpha, which is monic and therefore regular by Polynomial.Monic.isRegular. Cancel this factor to obtain the second reduction; this works for zero rings as well.

theorem lift_monic_coprime_factorization_h_reduction
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (f : A[X])
    (g₀ h₀ : (A ⧸ I)[X]) (hg₀ : g₀.Monic) (hh₀ : h₀.Monic)
    (hfactor₀ : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = g₀ * h₀)
    (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A')
    (g' h' : A'[X]) (hfactor : f.map φ = g' * h')
    (hgred : g'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map φ)) =
      g₀.map (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map φ) φ Ideal.le_comap_map)) :
    h'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map φ)) =
      h₀.map (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map φ) φ Ideal.le_comap_map)

blueprint_update.statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f\in A[X]$, and $g_0,h_0\in(A/I)[X]$ monic with $\bar f=g_0h_0$ in $(A/I)[X]$. Let $\varphi:A\to A'$ be a ring map, $\alpha:A/I\to A'/IA'$ the induced map, and $g',h'\in A'[X]$ with $\varphi(f)=g'h'$ such that the image of $g'$ in $(A'/IA')[X]$ is $\alpha(g_0)$. Then the image of $h'$ in $(A'/IA')[X]$ is $\alpha(h_0)$.

proof.text: Reduce $\varphi(f)=g'h'$ modulo $IA'$: the image of $\varphi(f)$ is $\alpha(\bar f)=\alpha(g_0)\alpha(h_0)$, and the image of $g'$ is $\alpha(g_0)$, so $\alpha(g_0)\cdot(\bar h'-\alpha(h_0))=0$ in $(A'/IA')[X]$, where $\bar h'$ is the image of $h'$. Since $g_0$ is monic, $\alpha(g_0)$ is monic, hence a nonzerodivisor in $(A'/IA')[X]$; therefore $\bar h'=\alpha(h_0)$.
